title: jmri-json-roster-server-message
description: Data portion of message from JMRI to client for type "roster". Sent when the roster changes; a rosterEntry is added, removed, or (when its identity changes) both. The roster itself is returned in response to a request as a list of "rosterEntry" messages.

add.description: A complete "rosterEntry" message for an entry added to the roster

data.description: Conforms to the server schema for type "rosterEntry"

remove.description: A complete "rosterEntry" message for an entry removed from the roster

data.description: Conforms to the server schema for type "rosterEntry"
